3469-4091-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Aphetto Alchemist doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-4091-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

512-7014-7308.easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
512-7014-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-7014-7308.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Mona Lisa's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

3101-3292-3892-7730.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3892-7730.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3892-7730.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

4050-5003-7283-7649.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Repeat.
4050-5003-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

1052-2438-3175.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

206-1256-1270-5477.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

650-891-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

204-1858-1903-2056-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-1903-2056-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2921-4294-5220.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from Step 3.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

1978-3443-5776.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1978-3443-5776.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat

129-3812-6006.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3812-6006.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

2292-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1432-4644--80.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
1432-4644--80.description:
If Tidewater Minion is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Tidewater Minion to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion and another legendary creature.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.

440-671-1339-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-671-1339-2034.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
When the Insect dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3330-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3330-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-2538-3676-4052.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Kindred Discovery trigger, causing you to return Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

640-2452-3249-5670--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
640-2452-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3457-5640.notablePrerequisites: Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
3457-5640.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Ertha Jo's second ability triggers, copying Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting any other creature.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and the other targeted creature.
Repeat.

104-475-3197-4321.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Cleric Class is at least level two.
104-475-3197-4321.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 2 life due to Cleric Class.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite Foods, you may sacrifice them to Peregrin Took's ability.

175-3028-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-3028-4222.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

405-1308-2232-2757.description:
Cast Resolute Reinforcements by paying {1}{W}.
When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Soldier token, untapping a basic Plains you control.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining Soldier token.
Repeat from step 1.

1812-2440-2967.description:
Activate Pashalik Mons by paying {3}{R} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pashalik Mons, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons ability from step 1, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
The Goblins enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice, adding {C}{C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1494-3314-3843.notablePrerequisites: Chulane does not have summoning sickness.
1494-3314-3843.description:
Cast Sage of Hours by paying {6}{U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve Sage of Hours, causing it to enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you take at least one extra turn after this one.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Sage of Hours from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2634-3593-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
2634-3593-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1517-2104-2402.description:
Play The Mirari Conjecture and Temporal Manipulation, then go to the next turn.
Use Conjecture's 2nd activation to add Temporal back to hand, then play Nesting Grounds.
Play Temporal Manipulation.
Go to the next turn.
Activate Nesting Grounds to remove a saga counter from Conjecture, then add back Temporal when Conjecture's 2nd activation triggers again.

366-1183-1636-4061.notablePrerequisites:
Dalakos does not have summoning sickness.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters.
366-1183-1636-4061.description:
Activate Dalakos by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent on artifacts or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Creature tokens enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

803-3413-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
